result.summary: Adds a checkbox in GUI send and fee-bumping confirmation dialogs allowing users to export unsigned transactions as PSBTv2 instead of the default PSBTv0. In the core codebase, it also removes the default version argument from the `PartiallySignedTransaction(const CMutableTransaction&)` constructor, requiring callers to explicitly choose the version.
result.problem: Many hardware wallets and external signing tools do not support BIP-370 (PSBTv2). Because Bitcoin Core previously defaulted to PSBTv2, GUI users exporting PSBTs to sign on external hardware encountered incompatibility errors, even though the GUI does not yet make use of PSBTv2-specific features.
evidence: Commit message: 'PSBTv0 is set by default since the GUI can't do anything interesting with PSBTv2 yet.'
result.changed_since_previous: Now includes the complete patch showing the addition of the BIP-370 checkbox to SendConfirmationDialog, its plumbing into SendCoinsDialog and WalletModel::bumpFee, and constructor updates across wallet and test code.
result.card: Adds a checkbox to the GUI send and fee-bumping dialogs to toggle between exporting PSBTv0 and PSBTv2, defaulting to PSBTv0. This fixes hardware wallet and external signer incompatibility (issue #36518) where devices reject BIP-370 transactions. It also removes the default version parameter from the PartiallySignedTransaction constructor to require explicit version specification across call sites.

risk.why: Incorrect PSBT version serialization or dialog checkbox state handling could prevent users from successfully exporting signable PSBTs to external signers.
